name: the notice -- sentence-level cases for Haro v0.28 (HARO-MENU-CITES-01)
comment: Written BEFORE the court code (the W discipline). Each case runs the court forged from notice_v28.haro on rnxc AND on the oracle; the two must print the same bytes. N3, N9 and N10 cite none; N4, N6, N7 and N8 cite what binds them; N5 keeps the default. The diagnose cases compare the first diagnostic's cites exactly. N13 and N14 were added after the court change: no case reached the SYMBOL path (world_lib.haro), so the notice gained an optional FOLLOWS seat typed by a SYMBOL that cites none, judged against notice/register.json.

cases.name: the clean notice is a sentence: one office, one desk, one notice
the meta-court reads the notice world: three menus, a range, a format, a union, a constraint, two refusals, a voice
a MENU that cites none: the envelope carries its code and no cite (the six envelopes of stzzui, case one)
a MENU that cites what binds it: rule:4, never rule:UNKNOWN_MEDIUM
a MENU without CITES keeps the default every court has cited since v0.11: rule:<CODE>
a RANGE cites the reader's right
a CONSTRAINT that cites none: its code, no cite -- where v0.23 to v0.27 could only cite rule:<CODE>
a REFUSAL that cites none, which a REFUSAL without CITES already did: the same envelope
the voice tells a refusal with what it cites: the medium's rule 4
contains: MEDIUM is board, letter or radio, not 'email'

cases.name: check speaks as it did: the refusal line carries the message, never the cites
contains: TONE is plain, formal or urgent, not 'shouty'

cases.name: a regulation the town's register holds resolves: the SYMBOL seat is lawful (added after the court, see GRAMMAR.md)
a SYMBOL that cites none: a regulation the register lacks is refused under its code with no cite (added after the court)
